tools.name: read_guide

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_guides · Public sink: claim_back_services.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_guides · Public sink: claim_back_services

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "list_guides" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
